summary: No held thesis is broken by evidence in the files. Equity ended at $625.09 (day -$1.21) with no fills. The single-stock book still lines up with this morning's fundamentals ranking: VRSN #1, CARG #2, IDXX #5, DPZ #6 and INCY #10 are all held. FAST, MSCI, WMT and KR are held below my top 10 but are still on the menu, which is no reason to sell. Every fundamentals-based invalidation clause is untripped. The menu is dated 11-10 and no new filing on a held name appears in the 11-11 news memory. The day's moves were small and are not thesis evidence: CARG -1.9%, MSCI -1.5%, DPZ +1.4%.
update: Clause-by-clause check, using only today's files. (1) DPZ: the invalidation needs DPZ to drop off the menu or CFO to fall below net income. It is still on the menu with CFO of $792M against net income of $602M, so the clause is untripped. Its Staples gp_sector_pct is still a wholesale-groceries SIC artifact (L3). (2) FAST: the invalidation needs a report showing CFO clearly below net income. It has not reported since 10-14 (next 2027-01-19), so the clause is untripped. (3) CARG, IDXX, MSCI, INCY and VRSN: each fundamentals clause needs a guidance cut, a reversed raise or a negative 8-K. The 11-10 and 11-11 news memory shows no filings on any of them, so all are untripped. Their stored numbers match this morning's menu: CARG CFO $295M against net income $156M; INCY CFO $1,413.5M against $1,286.7M; IDXX $1,182M against $1,059M. (4) WMT and KR: still on the menu, and their theses rest on screen pass plus Market Analyst sector favor. Fundamentals give no new signal. WMT's estimated ~11-19 print, which is unconfirmed, will bring a new quarter and is the next real fundamentals test. Stale-text flags for the PM (L6, L3): MSCI's stored thesis still says it 'adds a sector the book does not hold'. Since 11-11, though, FAST's thesis puts FAST in Industrials by bucket, and MSCI's label is also Industrials (Business Services), even though the business is index and financial data. So the claim is no longer accurate as written, and the PM should restate it through thesis_updates. VRSN's thesis rightly notes that the menu data predates its 10-22 Q3 print, and that still holds. Next run: (a) check whether a refreshed menu brings in new fiscal years for TTEK (reported 11-11), SBH (10-K filed 11-10), SMG and BLBD. None is held, but each would change my red flags. (b) If WMT drops off the screen after its print, review it rather than treating that as an automatic sell. (c) CARG's vol_252d of 0.412 sits close to the 0.446 screen cutoff, so it is the held name most likely to fall off the menu on volatility alone. If that happens, it is a screen exit to review, not a broken thesis. Lessons: no lesson names the Fundamentals Analyst. I used L3's label caveat and L6's stale-text rule only to flag the MSCI wording, and nothing in today's evidence conflicts with either.
